title: Games resume after the DTRA contract ends: an SF86 request puts his clearance in 'undefined'

tellings.quote: And this just happened to me in contact in the desert. I was using my security clearance last June.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, says that after his contract with DTRA, the Defense Threat Reduction Agency that deals with weapons of mass destruction, ended in 2024 or 2025, the strange "games" around him started again. He says a request to fill in an SF86, the US government form used for security clearances, left his clearance listed as "undefined". He ties this to a contact experience he had in the desert while using that clearance the previous June.
